events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in August 1969.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: 57 years since the legendary Woodstock Festival. Three days of peace, love, and music that changed everything. What's your favourite iconic performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 91
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of 'The King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who would have been 91.

angles.name: Tribute to Elvis
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Elvis Presley, who left us on this day. His music continues to shake, rattle, and roll generations. What's your top Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur would have been 55
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas on this day in 1996, he would have been 55 today.

angles.name: Tribute to Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 today. His powerful lyrics and influence are still felt across the world. What's your go-to Tupac anthem?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: We remember the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970, he would have been 84.

angles.name: Tribute to Jimi Hendrix
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 today. His guitar work redefined rock music forever. Which Hendrix track is your all-time favourite?

events.title: The Beatles released 'Abbey Road'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969, featuring iconic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. From the legendary cover to every track, it's pure genius. What's your favourite album moment?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders have been shaping rock for decades. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman and iconic rock 'n' roll star, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon released 'Imagine'
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released as a single in 1975, becoming a global anthem for peace.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon released the timeless anthem 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released by Apple
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music players and how we consume music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped? 25 years ago, Apple changed the game for music lovers everywhere. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating the world's favourite secret agent since 'Dr. No' premiered in 1962. Who's your ultimate Bond, and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We celebrate the birthday of the legendary musician and songwriter John Lennon, who would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Silly Walks' to 'Fawlty Towers', he's a true comedic genius. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles released 'White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eponymous double album, widely known as the 'White Album,' in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped the iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sounds fresh today. What's your standout track from it?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen performance?
